product.title: Cortech Solstice Safetyguard Durable Behavioral Health Bed with Guardrails - 101 / 101S3
product.body_html:
The Cortech Solstice Safeguard Bed emulates the therapeutic aesthetic of the Cortech Solstice Bed with added features to protect behavioral health patients from fall-related injuries. Its innovative design features raised, molded-in wall panels running partially along each bed length to aid in fall prevention.

  • Durable, one-piece, rotationally molded design for increased strength
  • Constructed of high impact “no break” polyethylene
  • Molded-in, raised head and footboard to prevent mattresses from sliding
  • Seamless, raised wall panels run partially along both lengths of the bed to prevent falls and fall-related injuries
  • Designed for use with a 36” x 75” mattress (sold separately)
  • Optional underside ballast doors (3 doors) for adding weight with sandbags (sandbags sold separately, loose sand not recommended) - order model 101S3
  • Option to bolt to the floor via concealed pilot holes and hardware of your choice (not included)
  • Easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
  • GREENGUARD Gold Certified
  • Noise Generation Test RAL-AN23-010 conclude half as many decibels produced in comparison to steel
  • Flame Retardant (passes Cal 133)
  • Manufactured to ISO Quality Standards in the USA
  • 10-Year Factory Warranty
  • Patent Pending

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
